subject: Evidence exchange: tabletop outputs, incident timeline & IR action plan
messages:
From: Aisha Gupta <security@finledger.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: jonas_weber@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: 2026-11-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: minute-level timeline, sanitized logs & SIG/CAIQ deltas (Oct 31 auth event)

Hi Marissa —

Thanks again for taking tabletop calls yesterday. As part of our upcoming SOC 2 re-audit we need a few items from Redwood related to the Oct 31 authentication anomaly you walked us through:

- A minute-level incident timeline (UTC timestamps preferred) covering detection, mitigation, and rollback windows; CSV output is ideal.
- Sanitized logs: auth events, token issuance, and related API calls for the affected tenant(s). We need redaction guidance (what you can remove vs. what must remain for forensic purposes).
- A one-page summary of corrective actions and planned runbook updates.
- SIG/CAIQ questionnaire deltas where your answers changed as a result of the event (not the whole questionnaire).
- Mapping of these items to common SOC 2 CC controls (or a pointer to your control mapping doc).

Timing constraints: our audit intake closes on 2026-11-08. If you can provide a timeline draft by 2026-11-03 and sanitized logs by 2026-11-05 that would keep us on schedule. We can accept a presigned S3 link for transfers; please indicate any retention/timebox constraints for the data.

I attached the FinLedger auditor questionnaire (just the relevant pages flagged). Let me know if you want a short call to align on redaction.

Regards,
Aisha Gupta
Head of Security, FinLedger
security@finledger.com

Attachment: finledger_questionnaire_v2.xlsx

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Aisha Gupta <security@finledger.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, neha_kapoor@redwood.com
Date: 2026-11-01T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: minute-level timeline, sanitized logs & SIG/CAIQ deltas (Oct 31 auth event)

Hi Aisha —

Appreciate the clear ask and the timeline. We can meet your deadlines; here's our proposed delivery plan: 

1) 2026-11-03 EOD — initial incident timeline (CSV) + one-page corrective actions summary (PDF).
2) 2026-11-05 EOD — sanitized logs package (sample included to confirm redaction level).
3) 2026-11-10 — SIG/CAIQ delta responses and an updated SOC 2 control mapping spreadsheet.

We will prepare a presigned S3 location and share ACL/TTL details with you in the timeline delivery email. For redaction, our default is to mask user identifiers and tenant-ids but keep full timestamps and event ordering; if you need more/less detail please confirm.

Attached is our SOC 2 mapping snapshot to speed reviews. I'll loop in internal owners below for execution.

Thanks —
Marissa
Director, Security & Trust Operations
Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

Attachments: redwood_soc2_control_mapping.xlsx

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, neha_kapoor@redwood.com, jonas_weber@redwood.com
Date: 2026-11-01T11:08:00-07:00
Subject: FW: Request: minute-level timeline, sanitized logs & SIG/CAIQ deltas (Oct 31 auth event)

Team — forwarding FinLedger's ask. TL;DR: timeline draft by 11/03, sanitized logs by 11/05, SIG delta + SOC2 mapping by 11/10. See Aisha's original note below.

Action items:
- Karthik: please generate the minute-level timeline CSV (utc_ts,event,actor,action,notes) and an initial ir_timeline_initial_draft.csv. Include start/end UTC and detection/mitigation markers.
- Neha: prepare SOC2 control mapping and extract the SIG/CAIQ delta answers; flag any control gaps. Attach redwood_soc2_control_mapping.xlsx and a short write-up.
- Jonas: pull an excerpt of the IR runbook we plan to provide (redacted) and draft the one-page corrective actions summary; see runbook_excerpt_redacted.pdf.

If any of these slip past the deadlines, escalate to legal@redwood.com (we may need an NDA addendum for raw telemetry). I put a placeholder S3 path in related_links for the transfer once we confirm redaction.

Thanks — getting this across the finish line keeps the audit on track.

On Nov 1, 2026, at 09:12, Aisha Gupta <security@finledger.com> wrote:
> Hi Marissa —
> 
> Thanks again for taking tabletop calls yesterday. As part of our upcoming SOC 2 re-audit we need a few items from Redwood related to the Oct 31 authentication anomaly...

Attachment: internal_task_list.md

From: Aisha Gupta <security@finledger.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: FinLedger Compliance <compliance@finledger.com>
Date: 2026-11-03T16:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Evidence exchange: tabletop outputs, incident timeline & IR action plan

Marissa —

Thanks for the quick turn. Confirming that proposed dates work for us (timeline draft 11/03 received; we'll review). A few notes on redaction and scope before you upload sanitized logs to the presigned S3:

- Please mask internal employee IDs and API keys.
- Preserve exact UTC timestamps and event order.
- Tenant identifiers may be hashed deterministically (we'll accept a salted hash) so we can correlate events without seeing tenant PII.
- Please include a readme that maps the column schema for the CSV and any transformations applied.

For the postmortem: a one-page executive summary plus a 1–2 page technical timeline is ideal. We would also like the corrective action plan to indicate expected completion windows and owners. Final delivery target for the postmortem + corrective plan: 2026-11-10.

I'll share our S3 presigned link once our compliance team confirms retention window. If you foresee delays, please flag them by EOD tomorrow so we can adjust auditor expectations.

Best,
Aisha Gupta
Head of Security, FinLedger
security@finledger.com

Attachment: none
